connections.why: Controlling purpose and audience in functional writing transfers directly to shaping voice in personal and creative writing
Reading non-fiction and media texts builds the analytical lens used to study how spoken and written language vary
Understanding the features of spoken language sharpens students' own speaking and listening performance
The expressive control practised in speaking feeds the distinctive voice expected in personal writing
Audience-awareness in writing is the same skill applied when adapting talk for a listener
Insight into how writers craft language equips students to read literary and non-fiction texts and write more deliberately
